Harry Shields (34) and Dan Patience (35) managed to catch and beat A.W.Jerman on the run-in, and we had won the "National" for the second time!

In Steve Williams' 5¾mile Road Run Table the name of Alan Jerman occurs next to last with a date of Mar. 40. With the maxim of "Lest we forget" in mind I would mention that Alan Jerman was unfortunately Belgrave Harriers' first fatality in World War II.
